reason: Adapts an open-source agent-loop architecture to an economics workflow; claims are about forecast benchmarks and audit transparency, not the loop.
Agentic framework with a three-layer loop and do-until stopping, but the abstract reports only safe end-to-end automation of scientific tasks, no evidence on the mechanism.
Multi-agent exam-paper pipeline with a planner-evaluator loop; claims are expert scores 43.0/45 and cognitive-level distribution, i.e. task outcomes.
Closed-loop LLM data curation; reported claims are classification accuracy against zero/few-shot baselines on four benchmarks.
Position paper arguing agent loops are single-ready-unit schedulers; contributes iteration policy via an explicit DAG plus a node state machine with termination guarantees.
Perceive-Plan-Act-Reflect assistant; claims are 88% task success and 30% latency reduction, task outcomes not loop-mechanism evidence.
Systematization of knowledge: taxonomy of agentic runtime attack vectors and defenses drawn from prior work.
Off-the-shelf ReAct loop wired to an edge VLM for robotic pick-and-place; results are task completion time, privacy and offline operation.
Benchmarks serialization formats (TOON/TRON) inside agentic loops; the studied variable is notation and the claims are token reduction and accuracy.
Lab-automation agent with a validation/error-correction loop; claims are 97% first-attempt protocol success and fewer interface actions.
Argues explicitly that stability is impossible in open-ended agentic loops and proposes a termination mechanism (Popperian Guillotine reset at U_crit) with simulation of agentic collapse.

Empirical comparison of grep vs vector retrieval across harnesses; the studied variable is retrieval strategy and the claims are answer accuracy.
Runtime controller mediating actions around the agent loop; ablations show recovery confidence and policy weighting set distinct safety-utility points, evidence on verification/gating.
Harness maintaining persistent engineering state and evidence-to-candidate binding across revisions, compared against Claude Code under matched backends; contributes loop state.
The Marketing Agent Loop is an organizational feedback cycle of marketing functions, not the control loop of a language-model agent.
A deterministic symbolic validator inside the agent loop is the contribution, with a 0.2% constraint-violation rate reported for it; contributes verification.
Confidential agent platform; claims are about encrypted persistence, auditability and TEE deployment, not about how the loop proceeds.
Deployed retrieval-grounded assistant; evidence is exam scores, human ratings and IslamicMMLU leaderboard position, i.e. task outcomes.
Comparative review of existing agentic frameworks (CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, Agno, n8n) proposing a taxonomy.
Deploys 13 LLMs under extended iteration budgets to measure whether they detect plateaus and stop; direct evidence on termination (Autonomous Sunk-Cost Fallacy).
Constraint-Grounded Self-Verification whose gain is shown to survive self-refinement and equal-compute re-prompting controls; contributes verification.
Same AEOS study: measures stopping failures and meta-reasoning under widened patience thresholds across 13 LLMs; evidence about termination.
Survey with a unified taxonomy of efficiency techniques across four stages of the agent loop.
LLM planner plus TimesFM sentinel for industrial defense; claims are breaches prevented versus LSTM and TCN baselines, domain metrics.
Actor-Critic-Distiller-Refiner loop applied to AC-OPF explanation; claims are ~96% explanation quality on the IEEE 39-bus system.
Multi-agent medical refinement loop; headline claims are 89% ethical-violation reduction and 92% risk downgrade, and convergence compares models not mechanisms.
Survey of agentic components (perception, memory, planning, tool use, coordination) with a comprehensive analysis framing.
Reformulates long-horizon execution as task-state management; the Manage-Execute-Audit loop keeps state outside execution and is compared against native agent loops under matched models. Loop state.
Survey of agent harness component taxonomy, evaluation logic, and model-harness coevolution.
Beginner's literature survey of agentic AI concepts, the agent loop, memory and five orchestration frameworks.
Compares three loop regulation designs (RWL vs SRL vs CRDAL) against each other on design performance and latent-space navigation; the regulation loop is the studied variable. Iteration policy.
Compares BM25 against dense retrievers inside a search agent; the claims are answer accuracy and evidence recall on BrowseComp-Plus.
Evaluates off-the-shelf agent chains (ReAct, AutoGPT) in energy operations; findings are governance, traceability and hallucination risk in deployment.
On-device agent framework; claims are 11.5% task-success improvement and 94.9% completion-time reduction over the strongest baseline.
Compares two agent-directed tree-search orchestrators (state-based vs context-based) against an agentic baseline and reports scaling with agent budget; contributes iteration policy.
Contribution is a disambiguation-focused synthesis and fine-tuning pipeline; the live agentic loop is only the evaluation harness and claims are tool-invocation success.
Off-the-shelf ReAct loop for optical networks; the studied variable is generic vs domain-specific tool abstraction, reported as 90% correctness and token savings.
Physical agent orchestrator over frozen VLA policies; claims are LIBERO-PRO 12.8->53.3% and real-robot success rates, a system beating a baseline on domain tasks.
Contribution is a post-training distillation algorithm (OSCD); the translator agentic loop is a training-time component with no runtime loop under study.
Replaces single-agent experience loops with Execute-Distill-Verify consensus gating on what enters memory, argued and evaluated against single-agent-loop learning; verification and loop state.
Quantifies livelocks and safety drift in agent loops with declaration-action gap and livelock metrics, then proposes forced termination primitives; evidence on termination.
Oracle-driven self-debugging loop is the contribution and is ablated against pure instructional and basic agentic baselines (91% vs 27%); contributes retry/repair.
Agentic program search is a means to discover retrieval programs; the reported claims are nDCG@10 gains for frozen encoders.
Formalizes the agent loop as a POMDP and evaluates two interventions separately: a predicate belief state (+11.4% multi-hop) and an exhaustion gate saving 39% tokens. Loop state and termination.
